blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein hai.

items: Qabil-e-bharosa applications ke liye testing zaroori hai kyunke yeh madad deti hai: (a) Code ki performance optimise karne mein (b) Bugs pehchanne aur theek karne mein (c) Program ka size kam karne mein (d) Code tez chalane mein
Programming ki aam ghaltiyon mein shamil hain: (a) Syntax error (b) Logic error (c) Runtime error (d) Upar wale sab
Unit testing ki tawajjo kis par hai: (a) Poori application test karna (b) Alag alag components ya functions test karna (c) User interface test karna (d) Database connections test karna
Unit testing ke liye Python module: (a) numpy (b) matplotlib (c) unittest (d) os
unittest aur pytest jaise testing tools ka bunyadi maqsad: (a) Program ka size barhana (b) Check karna ke code sahi chalta hai (c) Layouts design karna (d) Programs compile karna
Debugging mein breakpoints ka kaam: (a) Program tez chalana (b) Program ko khaas jagah rok kar us ki halat dekhna (c) Code ke kuch hisse chhorna (d) Code optimise karna
Debugging mein watch expressions ka kaam: (a) Variables ki values badalna (b) Program chalte waqt variables ki values par nazar rakhna (c) Program rokna (d) Output ke paigham dikhana
Step-by-step debugging ka kaam: (a) Program tez chalana (b) Ghalti aasani se dhoondne ke liye code aik line ek waqt chalana (c) Program ki performance barhana (d) Code compile karna
Exception handling ke liye Python keywords ka jora: (a) try-except (b) try-finally (c) try-catch (d) handle-throw

Programming mein profiling ka kaam: (a) User interface ka design behtar karna (b) Performance napna aur bottlenecks pehchanna (c) Sirf memory ka istemal optimise karna (d) Security ki kamzoriyan test karna
Qabil-e-bharosa applications ke liye testing kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 5.2.1)
Programming ki aam ghaltiyan aur bugs kaun se hain? (jawab: 5.2.1)
Unit testing kya hai aur programming mein kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: Unit Testing)
Python ke unittest aur pytest modules unit testing mein kaise madad dete hain? (jawab: Unit Testing)
Test cases likhne aur chalane ka maqsad kya hai? (jawab: Unit Testing)
PyCharm ya VS Code jaise IDEs mein breakpoints kaise lagate hain? (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
Debugging mein watch expressions se variable values dekhne ka kya kirdar hai? (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
IDEs mein step-by-step debugging ka tareeqa kya hai? (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
Exception handling kai qism ke exceptions sambhalne mein kaise madad karti hai? (jawab: Exception Handling)
Python mein profiling aur performance napne ke liye kaun se tools hain? (jawab: 5.3)
Qabil-e-bharosa applications ke liye testing kyun zaroori hai, aur program ki mazbooti (stability) mein is ka kya kirdar hai? (jawab: 5.2.1)
Software banate waqt hone wali aam ghaltiyon aur bugs par baat karein. (jawab: 5.2.1)
Unit testing kya hai, aur Python ke unittest aur pytest modules achhi testing mein kaise madad dete hain? (jawab: Unit Testing)
Python ke unittest ya pytest se test cases likhne aur chalane ka tareeqa samjhaiye. (jawab: Unit Testing)
Breakpoints aur watch expressions debugging mein kaise madad dete hain? Code ke masle pehchanne mein in ka kirdar bataiye. (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
PyCharm ya VS Code jaise IDEs mein breakpoints lagane ka tareeqa bataiye aur debugging mein in ki ahmiyat samjhaiye. (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
Step-by-step debugging kya hai, aur yeh Python programs mein bugs pehchanne aur theek karne mein kaise madad deti hai? (jawab: Using Breakpoints and Watches)
Python mein exception handling kaise kaam karti hai? Program crash se bachane ke liye kai qism ke exceptions kaise sambhalein? (jawab: Exception Handling)
